cohort: 613 neonates with culture-positive sepsis out of 4690 admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) between January 2012 and December 2016
finding: Extremely low birth weight, extreme preterm birth, preeclampsia, acute renal failure, coagulopathy, septic shock, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, CRP > 24, and abnormal absolute neutrophil count were significant predictors of mortality in neonatal sepsis.
